# go-modern-errors-is

**Since:** Go 1.13

## Summary

Use errors.Is(err, target) instead of err == target so wrapped errors are handled correctly.

## Details

errors.Is walks wrapped errors and honors custom Is methods.
Direct equality only matches the exact sentinel value and misses errors wrapped with fmt.Errorf or custom wrappers.

## Examples

### Before

```go
if err == os.ErrNotExist {
  return nil
}
```

### After

```go
if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
  return nil
}
```
